AcademyEarlIntroText:
EARL, I am!

Wonderful are
#MON, yes!

Teach you I will
to be a better trainer!

What you want to
know? Want to be a winner is you?
AcademyEarlTeachHowToWinText:
Good! Teach you,
I will!

In battle, #MON
top on list jump out first!

Change order in
list, make battle easy, maybe!

More from me you
want to hear?
AcademyEarlTeachMoreText:
So, want to know
how to raise #MON well?
AcademyEarlTeachHowToRaiseWellText:
Fine! Teach you,
I will!

If #MON come
out in battle even

briefly, some EXP.
Points it gets.

At top of list put
weak #MON.

Switch in battle
quick!

This way, weak
#MON strong become!
AcademyEarlNoMoreToTeachText:
Oh! Smart student
you are! Nothing more do I teach!

Good to #MON
you must be!
EarlsPokemonAcademyYoungster1Text:
I'm taking notes
of the teacher's lecture.

I'd better copy
the stuff on the blackboard too.
EarlsPokemonAcademyGameboyKid1Text:
I traded my best
#MON to the guy beside me.
EarlsPokemonAcademyGameboyKid2Text:
Huh? The #MON I
just got is hold- ing something!
EarlsPokemonAcademyYoungster2Text:
A #MON holding
a BERRY will heal itself in battle.

Many other items
can be held by #MON…

It sure is tough
taking notes…
AcademyBlackboardText:
The blackboard
describes #MON

status changes in
battle.
AcademyPoisonText:
If poisoned, a
#MON steadily loses HP.

Poison lingers
after the battle,

and HP is lost as
you walk.

To cure it, use an
ANTIDOTE.
AcademyParalysisText:
Paralysis reduces
speed and may prevent movement.

It remains after
battle, so use a PARLYZ HEAL.
AcademySleepText:
If asleep, your
#MON can't make a move.

A sleeping #MON
doesn't wake up after battle.

Wake it up with
an AWAKENING.
AcademyBurnText:
A burn steadily
consumes HP.

It also reduces
attack power.

A burn lingers
after battle.

Use a BURN HEAL as
the cure.
AcademyFreezeText:
If your #MON is
frozen, it can't do a thing.

It remains frozen
after battle.

Thaw it out with
an ICE HEAL.
AcademyNotebookText:
It's this kid's
notebook…

Catch #MON
using # BALLS.

Up to six can be
in your party.

Keep reading?
AcademyNotebookText1:
Before throwing a
# BALL, weaken the target first.

A poisoned or
burned #MON is easier to catch.

Keep reading?
AcademyNotebookText2:
Some moves may
cause confusion.

Confusion may make
a #MON attack itself.

Leaving battle
clears up any confusion.

Keep reading?
AcademyNotebookText3:
People who catch
and use #MON

in battle are
#MON trainers.

They are expected
to visit #MON

GYMS and defeat
other trainers.

The next page
is… Blank!

Boy: E-he-he…

I haven't written
anymore…
AcademyStickerMachineText:
This super machine
prints data out as

stickers!
